summary: Advises network operators who have an OSI NSAP addressing plan and want to move to IPv6 to design a fresh native IPv6 plan rather than reuse the old one. It is now historic and was replaced by RFC 4048.

eli5.summary: If you are moving to a new house, do not try to reuse the old floor plan. Draw a new one that fits the new place. This note told people to do exactly that with their network addresses.

questions: can osi nsap addresses be used with ipv6
how to move from osi addressing to ipv6
